title: Flappy Legs
description: Adds a custom enchant to make your legs flap flap!
body:
![Cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43920c28c8e7e8f7ad9f41ec71db377f0a5e553f.png)

Flappy legs lets you flap your legs, and boost yourself up into the skies!

This Fabric mod adds a new "Flappy Legs" enchantment.

<details>
<summary>How do I obtain the enchantment book?</summary>

"Flappy Legs" is a treasure enchantment which means you can **only** obtain it by trading with librarian villagers

![Enchantment Book Hover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9f39b8579386062a285a7acc89d9e6dc9fa18ce.png)
</details>


You can toggle the mod by pressing **K**, which is the _default_ keybind

"Flappy Legs" requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and needs to be installed both on the **client** and **server** side.

Currently supports all the 1.21 versions and 1.20-1.20.3 for **Fabric**.
